docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Sanskrit text of Pūrṇabhadra's Pañcatantra of 1199 with Hertel's introduction, in the Harvard Oriental Series (volume 11, 1908).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Panchatantra, a collection of ancient Hindu tales in the recension, called Panchakhyanaka, and dated 1199 A.D · Purnabhadra, Hertel, Johannes · 1908, 358 scanned pages. Published 1908; Johannes Hertel died 1955 and the series editor Charles Rockwell Lanman 1941; Pūrṇabhadra wrote in 1199; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
